results.name: nop_function_a
results.evidence: Decompiles to nothing but 'return;' with no parameters, locals or globals; size is 31 bytes (padding/alignment) with 5 call sites elsewhere, consistent with a default no-op callback rather than any device/game logic
results.summary: Empty function that does nothing and returns; likely used as a placeholder/default callback.

results.name: nop_function_b
results.evidence: Same pattern as FUN_00401000 (decompiles to only 'return;', no parameters or referenced data) but with 10 call sites and 39 bytes of code, suggesting a second, more widely used no-op placeholder
results.summary: Empty function that does nothing and returns; likely used as a placeholder/default callback in more locations than FUN_00401000.

results.name: generic_function_invoke
results.evidence: Body is a single forwarding call, FUN_00505880(param_1); FUN_00505880 is called from ai/camera/effects modules with a leading opcode-like integer constant (e.g. 0x21,0x23,0x27,0x33) and optional extra in/out pointer arguments, so this is a thin single-argument wrapper around that shared dispatch routine
results.summary: Thin wrapper that forwards its single argument to the shared FUN_00505880 dispatch routine used across several other modules.
